entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.2.2 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD card-keys — initial reference: TUI keybindings, prompt glyphs, activity rails and status symbols
  • ADD card-slash-core — initial reference: session management, context compaction, history export and model switching
  • ADD card-slash-tools — initial reference: planning mode, goal orchestration, browser automation and schedule cron timers
  • ADD card-cli — initial reference: print mode, NDJSON streams, JSON schemas, effort flags and subcommands
  • ADD card-settings — initial reference: settings.json keys for model defaults, reasoning effort, permissions and sandbox
  • ADD card-env — initial reference: API keys, project overrides, directory configs, sandbox flags and proxy support
  • ADD card-skills — initial reference: AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md hierarchical discovery, progressive disclosure and SKILL.md
  • ADD card-hooks — initial reference: lifecycle event hooks, plugin cross-imports and MCP server management
